correctness.rationale: Explicitly reconstructed 19 source facets, every 2-, 3-, and 4-face and local bistellar legality rule, and exhaustively checked the 27 edges/38 triangles/eight vertex stars. Found exactly two 2-to-3 triangle centers 123/456 sharing missing edge 78, six 3-to-2 centers 15,16,24,26,34,35 with listed opposite missing triangles, and no 4-to-1 moves. Enumeration of all 8! vertex permutations yields automorphism order 12 with transitive orbits of cardinalities 2 and 6. The source verifier additionally exhaustively compares the resulting 20-tetrahedron spheres against the Brückner–Grünbaum facet model and all 18-tetrahedron outcomes against one another; published eight-vertex sphere classification gives the 18-facet target polytopal. This is an exact finite graph/simplicial calculation, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: An exhaustive labeled local move fiber and symmetry-orbit census on Barnette’s minimal nonpolytopal 3-sphere is a natural sharp combinatorial invariant, upgrading the known coarse Hasse-graph adjacency to exact legal-center multiplicity and topology of adjacent targets. This is useful for Pachner-move algorithms and triangulation classification beyond an arbitrary small example; does not claim longer distances.
